LifeMax.label: Max life
LifeMax.tooltip: Particle life lies between LifeMax*(1-LifeVar01) and LifeMax (derived from GBX.NET's legacy conversion); short values fade fast in game.

LifeVar01.label: Life variation
LifeVar01.tooltip: Fraction of LifeMax removed at random: (max-min)/max.

SizeEndScale.label: Size at end of life
SizeEndScale.tooltip: Size multiplier at the end of the particle life (5 = particles grow huge), tested in game.

c002_U21.label: Size growth curve
c002_U21.tooltip: 4 made particles grow (and maybe fade) faster, tested in game. Nadeo: 1 to 2.

Weight.label: Gravity
Weight.tooltip: Gravity factor: negative falls, positive rises, tested in game. Nadeo: sparks -10/-5, TorchSmoke 8.

Viscosity.label: Air drag
Viscosity.tooltip: 0: particles keep their speed, 10: they stop right after emission, tested in game.

Persistence.tooltip: 1 showed no visible difference in game. Nadeo: Fogger8M 0.1, sparks 0.02.

Rotation.label: Rotation speed
Rotation.tooltip: Sprite spin speed, tested in game (2 = fast spinning).

c002_U13.label: Rotate particles
c002_U13.tooltip: 1 = particles rotate; 0: all particles keep the same orientation and do not rotate, tested in game. Nadeo: smoke 1, sparks 0.

IntensityPower.label: Fade curve
IntensityPower.tooltip: Exponent of the opacity fade over life; 0 = no fade (end particles stay dense), tested in game. Nadeo: Fogger8M 4.

IntensityFadeIn.label: Fade in
IntensityFadeIn.tooltip: Fraction of the life spent fading in (1 = only visible at the end), tested in game.

IntensityFadeOut.label: Fade out
IntensityFadeOut.tooltip: Fraction of the life spent fading out (1 changed the end of life visibly in game).

TextureAtlasDimX.label: Atlas columns
TextureAtlasDimX.tooltip: Sprite sheet grid; must match the bitmap (wrong values show cut tiles), tested in game. Nadeo smoke 4x4, sparkler 4x2.

TextureAtlasDimY.label: Atlas rows
TextureAtlasDimY.tooltip: Sprite sheet grid; must match the bitmap, tested in game.

UseEnergyOverLife.label: Energy colour over life
UseEnergyOverLife.tooltip: Colour goes white -> red over the life like cooling sparks, tested in game. Nadeo: main sparkler emitters. Colour over life (bitmap) wins over it.

UseHueShift.tooltip: Needed (with UseEmitterHue) for Hue and the effect node's LinearHue01, tested in game.

UseEmitterHue.tooltip: Use the hue set by the effect node (LinearHue01), tested in game.

c002_U10.label: Additive (glow)
c002_U10.tooltip: Set together with the next flag (1 / true) particles turn bright yellow-white: additive glow like the sparklers, tested in game.

c002_U11.label: Additive (glow) flag
c002_U11.tooltip: Set together with 'Additive (glow)', tested in game. Nadeo: sparks true, smoke false.

c002_U04.label: Distortion (heat haze)
c002_U04.tooltip: Particles become see-through and blur what is behind them, tested in game.

c002_U06.tooltip: True made particles darker in game.

c002_U14.tooltip: True made particles darker in game.

c002_U23.tooltip: True: particles appear at the spawn point and vanish immediately, tested in game. Guess: uses the c002_U22 lookup texture, which is empty.

c002_U18.tooltip: Probably a computed value (Fogger16M 113.097 = 36*pi); 0 and 500 showed no visible difference in game.

c000_U02.label: Loop period
c000_U02.tooltip: Emission briefly stops at regular intervals (1: slight pulses, 10: short stops every few seconds), tested in game. 0 = continuous.

c000_U04.label: Reverse direction
c000_U04.tooltip: Emits the opposite way (-Z instead of +Z), tested in game. Nadeo: only InFogEmitter.

c003_U03.tooltip: 1 looked like screen-space collision (particles stopped depending on the view), but the base effect shows similar blocking. Nadeo: InFogEmitter 1.

BitmapOverLife.label: Colour over life (bitmap)
BitmapOverLife.tooltip: Colour ramp read left to right over the particle life (around the middle row), only with 'Use colour over life'. Wins over energy colour and hue. A grey/transparent ramp gave plain white: only the colour is used, not brightness or opacity. Tested in game.

UseColorOverLife.label: Use colour over life
UseColorOverLife.tooltip: Required for 'Colour over life (bitmap)'; without a bitmap it changes nothing. Tested in game.

c002_U12.tooltip: Unnamed bitmap reference (probably another lookup texture). Not used by Nadeo; can't be tested yet: the converter writes unnamed members as text, not as texture references.

c002_U22.tooltip: Unnamed bitmap reference (probably another lookup texture, see c002_U23). Not used by Nadeo; can't be tested yet: the converter writes unnamed members as text, not as texture references.
